name: Kling AI
tagline: Kling AI is a text-to-video and image-to-video generation platform from Kuaishou, known for producing smooth, physically realistic video clips up to two minutes long. Its motion quality and ability to maintain character consistency across frames place it among the best AI video generators available. Filmmakers, advertisers, and social media creators use Kling to generate cinematic footage that would otherwise require expensive production.
